ClearSky

Pick the day and hour before you drive.

Scores are heuristics from the design doc, tuned for New England dew-point and wind habits until you calibrate them. A score is a guide to which hours deserve a closer look, not a promise.

Data: Open-Meteo forecast, air quality and ERA5 reanalysis (Copernicus); NWS cross-check; Zippopotam.us and OpenStreetMap Nominatim for places. Free tiers are for personal, non-commercial use. Only coordinates leave your device; nothing is stored anywhere but this browser.
